caption_used: Distribution of Quantifiers and Operations in Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, and Disjunctive & Conjunctive Reasoning. raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This figure presents three pie charts illustrating the distribution of quantifiers and operations across three reasoning categories: Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, and Disjunctive & Conjunctive. The first pie chart, titled "Categorical," contains four slices: Universal Quantifiers at 29.07% shown in light blue, Negation at 27.91% in orange, Limiter at 27.91% in pink, and Existential Quantifiers at 15.12% in light green, with the three largest segments being relatively close in proportion and Existential Quantifiers being the smallest. The second pie chart, titled "Approximate Number Generation," displays three slices: Approximate Quantities at 45.03% in pale yellow, Comparative Relationships at 36.26% in light blue, and Absolute Absence at 18.71% in light peach/beige, arranged with the largest segment occupying nearly half the chart. The third pie chart, titled "Disjunctive & Conjunctive," is divided into two nearly equal slices: Conjunctive at 50.49% in light pink/mauve and Disjunctive at 49.51% in light lavender, showing an almost even split between the two categories. All three charts include percentage labels displayed directly inside or adjacent to their respective slices along with category names, and none of the charts feature external legends or visually exploded segments.
